title: Verify Per-Placement Image Identity
task: Using docxedit only, inventory the images in the private input copy, including headers and footers, and note any media part used by more than one drawing placement.
If repeated placements exist, edit exactly one of them with set-image-alt guarded by expect-alt naming its current description, choosing the second placement when two share one media part.
Run docxedit check before apply and write the edited .docx under the run directory.

Read the output back and confirm only the intended drawing changed while every other placement keeps its state; report all placement IDs with changed/unchanged flags plus byte lengths, but no descriptions and no private image bytes.
If no repeated placements exist, stop after the inventory and report the placement IDs found without private text.
successCriteria: Addresses each edited drawing by its own placement ID, never by media part.
Shows readback where only the intended placement changed.
Does not inspect raw OOXML package parts or quote private document text.
Reports placement IDs with changed/unchanged flags and byte lengths, never descriptions or image bytes.
observerQuestions: Were per-placement IDs distinguishable when one media part was reused?
Did the expect-alt guard catch any wrong-drawing addressing before apply?
Could the agent verify from readback alone that neighbors were untouched?
applicability: Requires repeated image placements sharing one media part; without them, stop after the inventory and report the placement IDs found. That path is not-applicable, not success.
